reason: A DeepSeek Harness interface plugin focused on fullscreen reading, conversation-focused layout changes, collapsed tool-call summaries, message navigation, and related in-app reminders.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供全屏专注阅读界面，隐藏部分常驻区域并折叠工具调用，同时支持对话导航、设置保存和回复提醒。
summaries.en: Provides a fullscreen focus-reading interface for DeepSeek Harness with collapsed tool calls, conversation navigation, saved display settings, and reply reminders.

capabilities: Provides a fullscreen focus overlay for the chat interface
Hides or collapses selected interface regions and tool-call details
Renders conversation text and authorized conversation images
Provides message navigation, previews, smooth scrolling, and return-to-latest controls
Stores plugin display settings in localStorage
Displays reminders for new replies and AI response requests
